name: cyclo-plugin
description: Cyclo Plugin: source-backed ROBOTIS product guidance, retained AI Sapiens workflows and model-aware DYNAMIXEL Control Table operations.

interface.longDescription: Official-source ROBOTIS product guidance and AI Sapiens workflows, with model-aware DYNAMIXEL Control Table discovery, reads and writes. Hardware tools are available by default without startup device I/O; CYCLO_OFFLINE=1 disables hardware access. Source-bound conditions and explicit customer commands remain required. Runtime evidence is mock-only.
defaultPrompt: Help me select a DYNAMIXEL using the official manuals
Help me identify and configure a newly connected DYNAMIXEL safely
Prepare robot-arm ROS 2 control, DHI and Xacro configuration
